canonical_json: RFC8785 JCS encoded as UTF-8; duplicate JSON members and non-Unicode-scalar strings are rejected before canonicalization

root_secret.creation: one operating-system CSPRNG draw after ratified Stage-0 start and before any root or assignment draw
root_secret.storage: sealed secret store; never serialized into a model, reader, actor, report, or ordinary artifact
root_secret.binding_time: before assignment generation and before any model call

coupling_kinds.COMMON_SEED: Members have identical invocation topology and byte-identical seed_key JCS. Treatment fields may differ, but every retained seed-key field must match. The same backend seed and sampler configuration are mandatory at each paired ordinal.
coupling_kinds.ANALYSIS_PAIR_ONLY: Members are paired only by the analysis contract. They use distinct coupling groups and independently derived seeds; no stepwise common randomness is claimed.
coupling_kinds.INDEPENDENT: No random or analysis coupling is asserted.

seed_key.sampling_lane_rule: sampling_lane is invocation topology, not treatment identity: OPAQUE_DREAM, AST_DREAM, OPAQUE_TARGET_THINK, AST_TARGET_THINK, ORACLE_TARGET_THINK, or STRUCTURED_ONESHOT_THINK. SELF/EMPTY/OBSERVED/CROSSED/SHAM recurrent opaque rows all use OPAQUE_TARGET_THINK. The descriptive lane stays in the audit row and is excluded from seed_key.
seed_key.null_rule: A retained field with no semantic value is the JSON null value; it is never omitted.
seed_key.validation: For COMMON_SEED, group members must have byte-identical seed_key JCS and sampler_config_id. A mismatch in any retained field rejects the entire coupling group before calls. Changing any excluded treatment field leaves seed_key and seed unchanged. ANALYSIS_PAIR_ONLY members must not share a coupling_group.

derivation.message_octets: the exact RFC8785 JCS UTF-8 encoding of the seed_key object and no prefix, suffix, newline, or length field
derivation.mac: HMAC-SHA-256 with root_secret as the 32-octet key and message_octets as the message
derivation.seed_digest: all 32 HMAC output octets rendered as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
derivation.backend_seed_mapping: Interpret digest octets 0..3 as one unsigned big-endian 32-bit integer in [0,4294967295]. No signed conversion, modulo, range reduction, retry, or collision repair is permitted.
derivation.collision_rule: Equal backend_seed_u32 values in different coupling groups are retained and reported; they are not re-drawn. Full seed_digest and seed_key distinguish the groups.
derivation.sampler_contract: Every treatment-affecting sampler and runtime value is the literal value in runtime_envelope.json; output bytes never affect a seed or namespace.

required_common_seed_groups: Matched h=0/h=1 Dream-2 calls at the same root, z_side, sampling_lane, phase role, draw role, and resolver ordinal.
Matched q=0/q=1 Dream-2 calls only where the assignment manifest explicitly declares a common-topology q fork.
SELF versus EMPTY, OBSERVED, CROSSED, and SHAM recurrent Think calls at the same root, selected continuation, z_side, target_id, goal_twin, phase role, and resolver ordinal when both rows exist.
Dream-1 is invoked once per selected life and its immutable staged result is cloned; no h/q branch reruns Dream-1.
required_analysis_only_groups: Each structured one-shot Think row and its iterative AST comparator because their invocation topologies differ.
Each one-shot Dream result and recurrent Dream diagnostic comparison because their invocation topologies differ.

deterministic_nonmodel_namespaces.derivation: HMAC-SHA-256(root_secret, JCS({domain:'pcfl-compose-v2/nonmodel-seed',namespace,root_id,stage,object_id,ordinal})) with all six members present; use the first eight digest octets as unsigned big-endian uint64
deterministic_nonmodel_namespaces.dedicated_namespace: model_visible_identifier is defined by the separate closed contract below and does not use this generic nonmodel-seed message shape.
deterministic_nonmodel_namespaces.separation: The namespace string is mandatory and distinct. No model output, content address, corpus variant, timing, cache state, score, or error text is an input.

model_visible_identifier.key: the exact 32 root_secret octets; this is a deterministic harness derivation, not an additional draw
model_visible_identifier.message_octets: The exact RFC8785-JCS UTF-8 encoding of an object having exactly the required members. domain is the literal domain_utf8 string; namespace is the literal model_visible_identifier. session_scope is the exact closed object below. No prefix, suffix, newline, length, or hidden field is added.

session_scope.source: Copy these seven values from the assignment/session topology. A semantically absent value is JSON null and is never omitted. sampling_lane is the treatment-free topology lane from seed_key, not descriptive lane. operation_topology is one of DREAM1_32, DREAM2_16, THINK_D1_10, THINK_D4_31, ONE_SHOT_DREAM1_1, ONE_SHOT_DREAM2_1, or ONE_SHOT_THINK_D4_1.
session_scope.paired_equality: Corresponding COMMON_SEED rows and SELF/EMPTY/OBSERVED/CROSSED/SHAM treatment clones must have byte-identical session_scope JCS. h_or_q and every condition/variant/cut field are excluded even when their public payloads differ. An excluded-field-only mutation must leave every identifier byte-identical.

ordinal_rules.resolver_ordinal: The assignment row's zero-based resolver_ordinal. The model-visible operation_ordinal is exactly resolver_ordinal + 1. Preissued catalog or memory handles use JSON null. A one-shot batch receipt item uses resolver_ordinal 0 because its sole model operation is operation_ordinal 1.
ordinal_rules.source_ordinal: Zero-based stable source slot: catalog ordinal minus 1 for TREE_EVENT/RAW_A_EVENT; committed Dream-1 candidate position minus 1 for candidate handles/reads; 0 for the sole target memory handle; C01->0 and C02->1 for staged objects; JSON null for authored nodes. It never depends on source bytes or read results.
ordinal_rules.issue_ordinal: Zero-based count within identifier_kind and session_scope. Preissued candidate handles use their zero-based committed-pool position; the sole target memory handle uses 0. Read receipts/candidate-read capabilities use the count of prior successfully charged issuances of that kind. Authored-node and staged-object capabilities use the count of prior accepted mints of that kind. Counts advance only after the event named by issuance_role is accepted or charged; a rejected attempt mints nothing and terminality prevents a later reuse.
ordinal_rules.topology_mapping: Two clones with the same session_scope and the same ordered prefix of issuance_role/source_ordinal/resolver_ordinal tuples map that prefix to identical issue_ordinal values and therefore identical identifiers. If model-authored operation kinds, source slots, resolver positions, or mint counts diverge, subsequent tuples use each branch's natural zero-based order and may diverge. Payload/query text alone never changes a tuple or identifier.

model_visible_identifier.derivation_and_encoding: Compute HMAC-SHA-256(root_secret, message_octets), take digest octets 0..15 without integer conversion, encode those 16 octets with RFC4648 base64url using the URL-safe alphabet A-Z a-z 0-9 - _, omit both = padding characters, and prepend the identifier_kind prefix. The encoded payload is exactly 22 ASCII characters. No rejection sampling, case conversion, normalization, modulo, retry, collision repair, or entropy draw is permitted.
model_visible_identifier.visibility_and_collision_rule: Only the prefixed identifier is model-visible. The message object, digest, root secret, source/path/content identities, and equality-class bookkeeping are not. If two distinct message JCS byte strings produce the same complete identifier anywhere in the sealed manifest/roster, Stage 0 fails IDENTIFIER_COLLISION and the scientific roster is NOT_RUN; no redraw or suffix is allowed. Reuse of the same identifier for byte-identical messages in corresponding clone sessions is required, not a collision.

replay_policy.rule: A replay uses the source call's exact input bytes, seed key, full seed digest, backend seed, sampler/runtime envelope, and a fresh process. It is diagnostic and never replaces or changes the source scientific row.
replay_policy.allocation: In canonical scientific call_id order, replay-001 is assigned to the first eligible failed source call and replay-002 to the next distinct eligible failed source call. No third replay exists.

required_static_assertions: Golden paired h and SELF/EMPTY/CROSSED/SHAM rows have identical seed_key bytes, full digest, backend seed, and sampler_config_id.
Changing only an excluded treatment field preserves the seed; changing any retained field rejects a COMMON_SEED group.
Different namespace or coupling-group vectors are domain-separated.
Every model_visible_identifier golden vector reproduces exactly; its decoded payload is exactly digest octets 0..15 and all prefixes/ASCII lengths match the kind table.
Every model_visible_identifier message uses an issuance_role allowed by its identifier_kind; an unknown kind/role or an extra/missing message/session-scope member is rejected before derivation.

Corresponding treatment clones have byte-identical session scopes and identifiers through every corresponding topology tuple; excluded content/treatment/path/digest/length mutations preserve IDs, while an issuance-role/source/resolver/issue-ordinal change produces the separately derived branch-natural ID.
For every recurrent and one-shot row, model operation_ordinal equals resolver_ordinal + 1 exactly; zero/one-based confusion is rejected before rendering or generation.
ANALYSIS_PAIR_ONLY never implies equal seeds or stepwise coupling.
The generated manifest contains exactly 3414 scientific call opportunities plus two named non-replacing replay slots.
